svg.title: NWS forecasts from NOAA's archive minus KPMV's reports, Mar 31, 2026 to Oct 22, 2026
svg.desc: Histograms of forecast minus reported wind speed, gust and direction for the NWS forecast in NOAA's NDFD archive, at three issuance leads. Hours counted per bin; the dashed line is zero.
svg.text: NWS forecasts from NOAA's archive minus KPMV's reports, Mar 31, 2026 to Oct 22, 2026
Hours per bin. Right of the dashed line the forecast was above the report, left of it below.
Rows: the newest of four issuances a day at least 0, 6 and 24 hours before the hour.
n 4789 · median 0 kt · mean +0.1 kt · 1981 above, 2049 below

Speeds in whole knots, as a METAR reports. Direction only where the report gave one (not calm or variable). Source: docs/nws-gust-archive.md, scripts/windErrorsData.ts.
